computerSetup.title: Setup on this computer
computerSetup.desktopHint: Open the Timon desktop app on this computer: computer use only works while it is running.
computerSetup.desktopNoScreen: No screen was found for the desktop app.
computerSetup.needX11: An X11 session is required: Wayland is not supported. Log out and choose an X11 session.
computerSetup.a11yOptional: Optional: without it the agent works from screenshots only.
computerSetup.a11yUnsupported: Not available on this system for now: the agent works from screenshots.
computerSetup.a11yLinux: Turn accessibility on in the desktop session (GNOME: Settings › Accessibility, or run gsettings set org.gnome.desktop.interface toolkit-accessibility true), then reopen the applications. If it is still missing, install the AT-SPI bindings: sudo apt install python3-gi gir1.2-atspi-2.0 at-spi2-core (Debian, Ubuntu), sudo dnf install python3-gobject at-spi2-core (Fedora) or sudo pacman -S python-gobject at-spi2-core (Arch).
computerSetup.installXdotool: Install it with the command of your distribution:
computerSetup.pathAccessibility: System Settings › Privacy & Security › Accessibility, then turn Timon on.
computerSetup.pathScreen: System Settings › Privacy & Security › Screen Recording, then turn Timon on.
computerSetup.allowHint: macOS asks for each permission. If nothing opens, follow the path below the missing line.
computerSetup.allowFailed: Could not ask for the permissions. Is the Timon desktop app running?
computerSetup.restartHint: macOS only applies Screen Recording after Timon restarts.
computerSetup.restartFailed: Could not restart Timon. Quit and reopen it.
computerSetup.restartMaybe: After you allow Screen Recording, macOS may ask you to quit and reopen Timon: a Restart button appears here.
computerSetup.ready: Ready: the agent can control this computer.
computerSetup.journalHint: The last actions this agent took on the computer. Typed text is never recorded.
computerSetup.journalUnreadable: The journal could not be read.
